items.review_notes: Gap conversion correct; root x and warm cutoff fail. Predicted warming sign contradicts supplied empirical slope at this x. Cutoff-definition caution is appropriate but does not repair the algebra.

Complete but not one protocol JSON object. NEP/Jones numbers contain serious scale errors; ratio 2.9167 appears correct in prose. Trap-reduction causality asserted without discriminating data; proposed annealing/gettering recipe unsupported.

Equations partly correct; numerical inversion fails, then reported tau and fc violate tau=1/(2*pi*fc). Readout approximation loses measurable correction. Claim about cascade 3dB at readout pole neglects the carrier pole.

Invalid JSON escape and serious density/mobility/geometry errors. Hall alone does not determine lifetime (correct caution), but independent lifetime was supplied. Gain/time values violate supplied assumptions.

Corner and integrated RMS fail by large factors; dimensional/sanity checks absent. Claim that a generic real lock-in always reduces noise relative to a finite rectangular band is unjustified without transfer/support details.

Projected cosine statement correct; Planck/area/wavelength/power scale and responsivity multiplication fail. Unit spelling outside audited whitelist noted, but errors remain many orders of magnitude even if interpreted generously.

Two structured quantities pass. Explanation then converts .003 cm to 3 um instead of 30 um: failed physical/unit rubric despite correct numeric score. Absorption versus EQE distinction broadly appropriate.
Complete JSON with wrong schema (quantities unwrapped); ENBW and RMS arithmetic fail on manual inspection. pi/2*7.96 equals12.5, not15.915; 12nV*sqrt15.915 is47.9nV, not197nV.

reviewer: Codex analytic review; no human signoff
status: All eight responses individually inspected; qualitative failure findings, not a calibrated subjective score.
